title: OpenRouter Image Model Explorer
description: Browse and analyze available image generation models and their parameters.

pluginFunctions.name: List All Image Models

openaiSpec.name: list_models
openaiSpec.description: Retrieve a list of all available image generation models with technical details, formatted as a markdown table plus descriptions.

pluginFunctions.code:
function esc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/\|/g,'/');}async function list_models(p){const r=await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/images/models',{headers:{'HTTP-Referer':window.location.origin||'https://typingmind.com','X-Title':'TypingMind Plugin'}});if(!r.ok)throw new Error(`Failed to fetch models: ${r.statusText}`);const d=await r.json();const models=(d.data||[]).filter(x=>x&&x.id&&x.name);if(!models.length)return 'No image models found.';let md=`# Available Image Generation Models (${models.length})

`;md+='| Model | ID | Modalities | Aspect Ratios | Max Images | Notes |
';md+='|---|---|---|---|---|---|
';for(const o of models){const a=o.architecture||{},im=a.input_modalities||[],om=a.output_modalities||[];const modalities=(im.length&&om.length)?`${im.join('+')} → ${om.join('+')}`:(om[0]==='image'?'text → image':'—');const s=o.supported_parameters||{};const ar=(s.aspect_ratio&&s.aspect_ratio.values)||[];const arText=ar.length?(ar.slice(0,4).join(', ')+(ar.length>4?` +${ar.length-4}`:'')):'—';const maxN=(s.n&&s.n.max)||1;const notes=[];if(s.resolution&&s.resolution.values&&s.resolution.values.length)notes.push('res: '+s.resolution.values.join('/'));if(s.quality&&s.quality.values&&s.quality.values.length)notes.push('quality: '+s.quality.values.join('/'));if(s.background&&s.background.values&&s.background.values.length)notes.push('bg: '+s.background.values.join('/'));if(s.output_format&&s.output_format.values&&s.output_format.values.length)notes.push('fmt: '+s.output_format.values.join('/'));if(s.seed)notes.push('fixed seed');if(s.input_references)notes.push('ref images');md+=`| **${esc(o.name)}** | \`${esc(o.id)}\` | ${esc(modalities)} | ${esc(arText)} | ${maxN} | ${esc(notes.join(', ')||'—')} |
`;}md+='
---

## Model Descriptions

';for(const o of models){if(o.description)md+=`**${o.name}** (\`${o.id}\`)
${o.description}

`;}md+='
_Use the model ID (e.g. `provider/model-name`) with **Get Model Endpoints** to see provider-level pricing and availability._';return md;}
